question: Can an independently mapped OSM entrance width plus its host-wall tangent define a portal interval that remains inside two source-disjoint Panoramax perspective images for at least three buildings?
information_change: Replace the consumed entrance point ray with a width-first ground-plane interval. Panoramax remains only the real-image carrier. Do not change the portal matcher, crop backbone, threshold, tracker or fusion rule.

providers.search_contract: place_position=<entrance lon,lat>, place_distance=3-30, place_fov_tolerance=180, limit=1000, sortby=id

geometry.width_parse: Accept decimal point or decimal comma from the frozen OSM width tag; units are metres.
geometry.wall_tangent: Use the normalized chord from the previous to the next host-building vertex around the exact entrance vertex.
geometry.portal_interval: entrance centre plus or minus width/2 along the host-wall tangent

projection.eligible_sensor: Perspective items only: 0 < pers:interior_orientation.field_of_view < 180, declared sensor columns/rows, view:azimuth, quality:horizontal_accuracy and an HD asset.
projection.horizontal_field_of_view_semantics: STAC Perspective Imagery field_of_view is the horizontal observable extent in degrees.
projection.camera_uncertainty: Sample the full declared horizontal-accuracy circle at one-degree increments and project both width endpoints from every sampled camera position.
projection.robust_visibility: The camera uncertainty circle must not contain the entrance, and the complete endpoint-bearing envelope must remain inside the reported horizontal field of view.

selection.per_collection_item: Minimize endpoint-bearing uncertainty width, then camera distance, then item UUID.
selection.pair_rule: Across distinct collections minimize the larger uncertainty width, then their sum, then collection UUIDs and item UUIDs.
selection.role_order: Lexicographic collection UUID then item UUID; first is REFERENCE and second is QUERY.

pixel_admission.review_surface: Each reviewer sees only its three role-specific images with the frozen uncertainty band and nominal width interval overlaid.
pixel_admission.admitted: Exactly one functional pedestrian entrance portal intersects the nominal interval and remains the unique plausible portal inside the full uncertainty band.
pixel_admission.ambiguous: More than one plausible portal lies in the band, or the band/occlusion does not support one unique portal.
pixel_admission.not_visible: No functional pedestrian entrance portal is visible in the band.
pixel_admission.formal_rule: Run one disjoint three-episode role audit. Continue to the unchanged portal-transfer matcher only if all three episodes are ADMITTED in both roles; otherwise close without matcher tuning.

stop_condition: One frozen metadata replay and one disjoint pixel admission. Do not tune source geometry, pose uncertainty, pairing or matcher after pixels.
claim_boundary: A pass is Development evidence that mapped entrance width can localize a unique portal interval across real Panoramax collections. It is not public/legal access, traversability, collision-free motion, a metric arrival waypoint, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, user benefit or mobility-safety evidence.
